skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the role of government in economic and social management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of the state in economic and social management.
Understand and use tools for policy analysis.
Develop systematic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Develop effective communication, presentation, conflict resolution, time management, and resource management skills.
Develop teamwork and group management skills.
Develop research and forecasting skills to solve policy issues.

Develop awareness of social responsibility, professional ethics, and learning abilities.
